name: maxim-runtime
description: Maxim's in-engine runtime for Claude Code (function hooks): the operating standard in the system prompt, a hybrid keyword and model router shown in the status line, enforced junction, secret-commit and CSO guards, confidence-tag checks, a /maxim panel, and an in-process framework lookup. Companion to the maxim plugin; needs Claude Code with function-hook support.

router.title: Maxim router
router.description: hybrid: keyword routing, with a small-model classifier only when the keywords are unsure. keywords: keyword routing only, no model calls. off: no routing.

guards.title: Maxim guards
guards.description: Block writes through .mxm-system and .claude junctions, block git commits whose diff carries a secret, and add the CSO review note when a security-sensitive file is edited.
